body_1:
Hey Ava,

Your booking page works for people who've already decided, not the ones still asking questions.

So I put together a private preview of AYA, our AI assistant, trained on radiantskinclinic.com and dressed in your branding. It's one link. Call her, then chat with her as she'd look on your Instagram.

Want the link to message her like a new client would? Just reply "yes" and it's yours in two minutes.
body_2:
Hey Ava,

Picture someone messaging your Instagram about booking an appointment while your team is busy. AYA answers, takes the time they want and passes it to your desk to confirm. So the morning starts with inquiries handled, not voicemails to return.

She can also send your deposit link in website chat. Your preview does exactly that, with your own services. Should I send it?
body_3:
Hey Ava,

Before you try her, two quick things. She never gives medical advice and only quotes the prices you set. And we sign a business associate agreement and handle clients' data under it.

Don't take my word for how natural she sounds. Call her yourself.

If another person at Radiant Skin Clinic handles the phones, who's best to send the preview to?
